title: Preallocate JOIN schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when join paths build schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added join_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced join base scan schema lookup key construction.
Replaced comma-join reorder schema lookup key construction.
Replaced right probe schema lookup key construction.
Replaced first-relation projection pruning schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Join schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving join planning, projection pruning, row-cache behavior, and SQL join results.
